description.en:
Schedules a jump from the current map to its parent map (the wider area map it belongs to), remembering where to come back.
It reads the current map's environment settings (MAP_ENV): ParentID gives the destination and GroupID a group number. On the map me01i01 a destination stored by the game is used instead, with group 999. It records the current map, the group and the position and direction of a party character (probably the one the player controls) as the return point, then schedules the jump.
Called with exactly 4 arguments, it does nothing.

true (also in the 4-argument case where nothing is done).
null if the current map cannot be found or the script system is not ready.

examples.case: At the end of an event (real usage, from ev42050400.nut)
